description: This file contains a JSON schema and API specifications related to Dynamic DNS Service Providers, including multiple endpoints (list, get, set), response schemas, and provider instances. It defines request/response structures, possible response types, and certain constants governing interaction with Dynamic DNS services within the system.
external_methods: Paths for listing, retrieving, and setting Dynamic DNS Providers

methods.name: Services.Local.DNS.Dynamic.Providers.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Dynamic DNS Service Providers, with support for pagination.

methods.name: Services.Local.DNS.Dynamic.Providers.{ProviderId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves details and status of a specific Dynamic DNS Service Provider identified by ProviderId.

methods.name: Services.Local.DNS.Dynamic.Providers.{ProviderId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies configuration parameters and state of a specific Dynamic DNS Service Provider.
